Your task: adapt the reference template above so it works with the new Notion database. Replace DATABASE_NAME_PLACEHOLDER with the real database name, DATABASE_ID_PLACEHOLDER with the real database id, PRIMARY_TEXT_PROPERTY_PLACEHOLDER with the most relevant title/rich_text property name from the schema, and TAG_PROPERTY_PLACEHOLDER with the most relevant select/multi_select property name (omit that filter branch entirely if none exists).

JSON output rules:
- Return valid JSON only: properly quoted keys/values, no trailing commas, correctly nested braces and brackets.
- Any "jsonBody" field on an httpRequestTool node MUST keep using the native $fromAI(...) expression syntax exactly as shown in the template. NEVER replace it with a literal placeholder string like "{keyword}" — that breaks the tool at runtime.
- Preserve the exact node type/typeVersion values from the template unless a field genuinely needs to change for this schema.
- Output with real line breaks so the JSON stays human-readable.

parameters.content:
# Generate and deploy an AI chat assistant for any Notion database
# 📥  [Open full documentation on Notion](https://app.notion.com/p/automatisation/Course-Generate-and-deploy-an-AI-chat-assistant-for-any-Notion-database-39e3d6550fd98123817cec0b54ce6aa0)

## How it works
Paste any Notion database URL into the chat. The workflow fetches its schema, an AI agent adapts a proven Notion-assistant template to that exact schema (right property names, right database ID), self-checks the generated JSON (including a known "jsonBody placeholder" bug), retries up to a configurable limit, and then **deploys the finished assistant directly into your n8n account via the n8n REST API** — no manual copy-paste. You get a clickable link back in the chat.

## Setup
1. Connect your **OpenAi account** and **Notion account** credentials on the relevant nodes (they are pre-selected if you import into the same account this was generated in).
2. Share the Notion databases you want to turn into assistants with your Notion integration.
3. Create an **n8n API Key** credential (httpHeaderAuth) — n8n UI: Settings → n8n API → Create an API key → copy it. Create a new credential of type "Header Auth", Name: `X-N8N-API-KEY`, Value: your key. Select it on the "Deploy Workflow via n8n API" node.
4. Open the **Configuration** node and set `n8n_instance_url` to your instance base URL (e.g. `https://n8n.yourdomain.com`, no trailing slash).

## Requirements
- An OpenAI API key with GPT-5.4 family access (OpenAi account credential).
- A Notion integration connected to your workspace (Notion account credential) with access to the target databases.
- Your own n8n REST API key (self-hosted or Cloud) for the auto-deploy step. Without it, the workflow still works — it just returns the JSON in chat as a fallback instead of deploying automatically.

## Customization
- Edit the **Configuration** node to change the generator model, the fixer/classifier model, generation temperature, or the max retry count.
- Edit the reference template embedded in **Prepare Agent Input** if you want generated assistants to use a different memory window, different tools, or a different system prompt style.
- The deploy step creates workflows inactive and unpublished by default — review each one before activating.

Need help customizing?
Contact me for consulting and support : [Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/doctor-firass/)

# MY NEW YOUTUBE CHANNEL
👉 [Subscribe to my new YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@DrFiras_AI). Here I'll share videos and Shorts with practical tutorials and FREE templates for n8n.

[![The AI Doctor](https://www.dr-firas.com/the-ai-doctor.png)](https://www.youtube.com/@DrFiras_AI)

## 1. Capture input & fetch schema
Chat trigger centralizes config, extracts the Notion database URL, and pulls + simplifies its schema.

## 2. AI generation
An agent adapts a proven Notion-assistant template to the new schema and returns strict JSON via a structured output parser (with auto-fix).

## 3. Self-validation + retry loop
Checks for the known jsonBody placeholder bug and for malformed JSON, retries with feedback up to Configuration.max_retries, then gives up gracefully.

## 4. Auto-deploy
Builds the n8n API payload and creates the workflow directly in your account via POST /api/v1/workflows, replying with a clickable link. Falls back to copy-paste JSON if deploy fails.
